articles.description:
Hundreds of Bitcoin wallets tied to the defunct Silk  
Road darknet marketplace have suddenly reactivated, sending about $3.14 million  
in BTC to a newly created address in their largest move in years. 
Blockchain data provider Arkham reports that the  
transfers came from a cluster of long-dormant wallets and landed in a Bech32  
address starting with “bc1q,” whose owner remains unknown.​
The transfers mark a sharp break with the pattern of
